name_zh: 梅克尔/德国/危机管理/能源转型/难民/东德物理/默克尔主义
description_zh: 安格拉·梅克尔 (1954-) 德国首位女总理 (2005-2021)，四次连任十六年，欧元危机/金融危机/新冠疫情/难民危机四大危机管理，能源转型推动核电退出/可再生能源主导，2015年开放边境接收百万难民，东德物理学家出身赋予理性务实决策风格。
description_en: Angela Merkel (1954-) Germany first female Chancellor (2005-2021), four terms sixteen years, Euro crisis/financial crisis/COVID pandemic/refugee crisis four crisis management, energy transition driving nuclear phase-out/renewables dominance, 2015 open borders received million refugees, East German physicist background endowed rational pragmatic decision style.
reason_zh: 梅克尔代表物理学家如何将科学理性转化为政治治理核心竞争力，展示了危机管理如何通过渐进主义与务实主义化解系统性风险，其默克尔主义（务实/渐进/理性/共识）成为现代危机治理教科书范式。
reason_en: Merkel represents how physicist transforms scientific rationality into political governance core competency, demonstrating how crisis management resolves systemic risks through incrementalism and pragmatism, her Merkelism (pragmatic/incremental/rational/consensus) becoming modern crisis governance textbook paradigm.

总结危机管理/能源转型/难民开放/物理思维/默克尔主义五重遗产

Analyze 2008 financial crisis/2010 Euro crisis/banking union/fiscal compact

Summarize crisis management/energy transition/refugee open/physics thinking/Merkelism quintuple legacy

expected_en: Master how scientific rationality transforms into political decision core competency, grasp incrementalism balancing principle and compromise in crisis, evaluate Merkel sixteen years governance decisive shaping for EU integration/German energy/refugee policy.
